page.overview:
What is Astronomy tower?

The Astronomy Tower was the tallest tower at Hogwarts Castle. It was where students studied the stars and planets through their telescopes in Astronomy lessons with Professor Aurora Sinistra. This was usually done at midnight, when the stars were best seen. The tower was generally out-of-bounds except for classes.

On the ground to third floors, the tower contained various passages to other parts of the castle. On the fourth floor, it accommodated a spacious hallway that connected to the Magical Theory classroom and a bathroom. The classroom was adjacent to the Magical Theory professor's office. The fifth floor contained a corridor and a reading room, as well as the Astronomy professor's living quarters. Further up were the Astronomy Room and the battlements of the tower.

During the 1890–1891 school year, one of the most advanced astronomy telescopes available to wizardkind was placed in this tower for the students and staff to use. During the same school year, the Bloody Baron would often linger in the tower's staircase, staring wistfully at the stairwell's Enchanted Ceiling which depicted the night sky.

During the 1991–1992 school year, Harry Potter's first year, he and Hermione Granger sneaked under his Cloak of Invisibility to the top of the Astronomy Tower to send Rubeus Hagrid's pet dragon, Norbert, to Charlie Weasley in Romania. Although they succeeded in sending Norbert away, they were caught by Argus Filch on their way down the tower, as they had forgotten to bring the Cloak of Invisibility with them. Professor McGonagall also caught Neville Longbottom and took away 150 points from Gryffindor.
